title: Automated Integration and Intelligent Harmonization of Multi-source Geospatial Data for Urban Land Record Management
region: Telangana State & Hyderabad Urban Agglomeration, India

datasets.name: Telangana State Groundwater Monitoring Well Network (2007-2026)
datasets.description: Comprehensive statewide piezometer and borewell dataset comprising 188,877 monthly observations across 1,769 active monitoring stations. Includes water level (mbgl), aquifer classification, seasonal fluctuation, and over-exploitation stress analysis.
datasets.department: State Ground Water Department (SGWD), Government of Telangana

datasets.name: Telangana Cadastral Revenue Boundaries & Urban Parcels
datasets.description: State-wide administrative boundaries and revenue village cadastre parsed and reprojected from Survey of India LCC shapefiles (10,455 revenue villages across 33 districts). Features LGD codes, perimeter, parcel area, and urban land record layers for Hyderabad, Medchal-Malkajgiri, Ranga Reddy, Sangareddy and Adilabad.
datasets.department: Department of Land Records & Survey / Survey of India (SOI)

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap Real Road Corridors & Building Footprints
datasets.description: High-fidelity vector corridors, transit ways, arterial links, and structural polygons extracted directly from local OSM spatial XML data (map.osm). Utilized for statutory Right-of-Way (RoW) buffer conflict detection and infrastructure alignment.

datasets.name: NASA SRTM 30m Digital Elevation Model (DEM)
datasets.description: 1-ArcSecond (30-meter) terrain elevation raster covering the Hyderabad metropolitan watershed and Telangana plateau (17°N, 78°E). Used for drainage slope calculations, flood vulnerability zoning, and 3D terrain profile modeling.
datasets.department: NASA / USGS Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM)

datasets.name: USGS / NASA Landsat-8 Multi-Spectral Satellite Raster
datasets.description: Level-1 Terrain Corrected (L1TP) 30-meter resolution satellite imagery (Path 144, Row 048) covering Telangana. Optical Blue Band (0.452 - 0.512 µm) with 16-bit radiometric fidelity used for spectral water body indexing, turbidity detection, and land use classification.
datasets.department: USGS Earth Resources Observation & Science (EROS) / NASA

datasets.name: Urban Parcel Cadastre (Conflict Benchmark)
datasets.description: High-density cadastral parcels configured with deliberate micro-scale sliver gaps, multi-owner boundary overlaps, and arterial road buffer intersections for automated AI harmonization demonstration.
datasets.department: Department of Land Records & Surveys, Telangana

datasets.name: Emergency Relief Shelters & Triage Centers
datasets.description: Designated municipal disaster relief facilities with capacity, current occupancy, medical teams, and emergency supply routing.
